I will keep wheat-maize as the center of my year because that is the most reliable way for me to use my land, water, and experience. I have farmed a long time, so I will not spread myself too thin with too many changes. I will put most of my land into winter wheat followed by summer maize, because that fits my usual system, gives me grain and income, and works well with well irrigation. I will keep a small area in cotton because it brings cash, but I will not expand it too much because it needs more watching and more spraying. I will also keep a small mungbean area because it is simple, does not need much water, and helps me avoid putting all my summer land into one crop. Since some family members work off-farm, I will favor familiar seed, moderate fertilizer, and field operations that save labor and keep yields steady rather than chasing the highest possible output.
